hypothesis: Holding illiquid assets yields a premium over time.
framework: Rank coins by how much price moves per dollar traded over a 21-day lookback. Buy the 10 least liquid names and sell the 10 most liquid, 50 bps of notional per name, rebalanced weekly on Mondays and held for one week.
notes: The worked example from the brief. I expect the long leg to carry negative funding and the short leg to be the liquid large caps; the question is whether the premium survives costs at 10 names a side.
